name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
description: A wand of blue-grey metal that tingles in the hand.
body:
## What it does

Point it and speak, and a bolt of lightning leaps out in a line. Spend more charges for a stronger bolt.

## Charges

It holds seven and regains 1d6 + 1 each dawn. Spend the last and it may crumble to ash.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.note: each further charge raises its level by one, up to 3 charges

charges.last: roll a d20; on a 1 it crumbles to ash
